subject: Energy
title: Nuclear Policy Debates
description: A short lesson to help you apply Nuclear Policy Debates.

hook.text: Nuclear power divides environmentalists—some see it as essential for clean energy, others as an unacceptable risk.

buildup.text: Germany shut down its last reactors in 2023—choosing to phase out nuclear despite its low-carbon output.

discovery.text: France generates 70% of electricity from nuclear—enjoying some of Europe's lowest emissions and cheapest power.

twist.text: New small modular reactors (SMRs) promise cheaper, faster construction—but none are commercially operating yet.

climax.text: The IPCC includes nuclear in most pathways to net zero—suggesting it's likely needed alongside renewables.

punchline.text: Love it or fear it—nuclear remains in the climate debate.

quiz.question: What percentage of France's electricity comes from nuclear?
